_about: Standing backlog (Chief, 12 Oct 2026; Ben: the Mini works 24/7). scripts/refill.py adds the next of these to the queue whenever fewer than 3 Mini jobs are ready. Every item is no-spend (no Vertex, Flow, ElevenLabs or any paid call), never deletes anything, never makes a video public, never replaces an armed Test & Compare, and ends parked for Chief (PASS gate) unless it only reads. A key is not re-added while a job from it is open or claimed, nor within every_h of the last one; if nothing at all is ready the oldest key is added anyway (never empty). Lowest tier: jobs.order runs backlog jobs only when no pipeline job is ready. Weekly audits and idea/script drafts for both channels lead (Ben, 12 Oct 14:36). An item with "paused" is skipped until the Chief removes it; a key with 2 jobs parked for Chief is skipped until one is ruled (refill.PARK_CAP, 21 Oct).

items.title: Daily Studio read: long films (impressions, CTR, views, avg % viewed) + Shorts (views, avg % viewed, stayed to watch) -> tracker
items.body: Free, read-only. Runs daily after the 06:40 snapshot and must finish before 09:00 London (Ben, 12 Oct 22:19). 1) In YouTube Studio, read only, change nothing: Orbit With Ben in the Orbit Studio browser (CDP 9223); History of Science in its own signed-in Studio session (never the 9222 Flow browser for Orbit pages). 2) For every long film (format long in 05_Analytics/dashboard/data.json, both channels), open Analytics > Reach for the video, period Lifetime, and read Impressions and Impressions click-through rate (%), and on Overview/Engagement the lifetime Views, Average view duration (seconds) and Average percentage viewed (%; if Studio shows only duration, compute duration / video length x 100). 2b) For every Short (both channels), read lifetime Views, Average percentage viewed (%) and 'Stayed to watch' (%, Studio's Shorts engagement figure, viewed vs swiped away); write them under the same videos map as "views", "avgViewPct" and "stayedToWatch" (Ben, 12 Oct 22:50). 3) Write 05_Analytics/<owb|hos>/studio_ctr.json: {"readAt": <ISO UTC>, "period": "lifetime", "videos": {"<videoId>": {"impressions": <int>, "impressionsCtr": <number, % e.g. 3.8>, "views": <int>, "avgViewSeconds": <int>, "avgViewPct": <number, %>}}}. A film Studio can't show yet: leave it out. 4) Rebuild: cd 07_Content-Ops && npx tsx scripts/analytics-report.ts (it merges studio_ctr.json into data.json; Studio values take priority on the tracker), then python3 scripts/board_publish.py so /tracker's 'Long films vs targets' panel fills in. 5) Commit only those files to main with a message naming the counts, then jobs.py done <id> --result "<n> OWB + <m> HOS longs; CTR hits vs 4%: ..." --git. Never: edit any video, title, thumbnail or setting; spend anything; paid API.

items.title: Weekly OWB audit: our YouTube numbers + competitors -> next-video improvements
items.body: Weekly growth audit for Orbit With Ben (aim: numbers up month on month). 1) Pull last 28 days and last 7 days from YouTube Analytics with the read-only tracker sign-in (YT_ANALYTICS_REFRESH_TOKEN_OWB; 05_Analytics tools): views, impressions CTR, AVD/retention curves, subs per video, Shorts vs longs, traffic sources, search terms. 2) What's working and what isn't: top/bottom 3 by CTR and retention, with the frame or title that explains it. 3) Competitors: 5 reference channels (Astrum, History of the Universe, SEA, Kurzgesagt, melodysheep) last 30 days via public pages/yt-dlp metadata only: titles, thumbs, lengths, view velocity, topics trending. 4) Write 05_Analytics/weekly_audit/OWB_<YYYY-MM-DD>.md: findings, then 3-5 concrete changes for the next films in production (title/thumb/opening/length/topic), each tied to a film id, plus 3 new video ideas ranked by evidence. Compare with last week's file and say what moved. 4b) Shorts lab (Ben, 21 Oct 2026, from Gemini's read of the HOS gold Short: 44% viewed on 25 s, the feed stopped after the first pool): for every Short public 48 h or more and not yet in the table, add one row to the Shorts lab table in 05_Analytics/LEARNINGS.md: id, title, length (s), views, stayed-to-watch % (Studio's Viewed vs swiped away; from the daily Studio read, studio_ctr.json), average % viewed, the second where the retention curve (Analytics API audienceWatchRatio by elapsedVideoTimeRatio) falls most, and what is on screen and said at that second (from the Short's cut list and VO words). Targets: stayed-to-watch 70%+, average viewed 70%+ (100%+ means rewatches). 4c) Learnings: turn this week's evidence into at most 3 rules or tests in the Learnings table of LEARNINGS.md (rule, evidence with ids and numbers, status: test/proven/dropped). A rule proven on 3+ Shorts is proposed to the Chief for the Shorts brief and the playbook; a test names the next 2-4 Shorts it runs on. Keep the audit itself to one page: what moved, the lab rows, the rules. Spend nothing: existing subscriptions and free tools only, no paid API, no TTS or picture generation in these growth jobs (credits are for pipeline VO and picture; floors are 0, Ben 12 Oct 14:46), no Studio or publish change. End with jobs.py block <id> --reason "parked for Chief: <what to decide>" --git.
